name: Inclusive Therapists
one_liner: Directory connecting clients with therapists who center identity, justice, and liberation. $10/month listing.
short_description: Inclusive Therapists is a social justice-focused directory helping clients find therapists who practice from anti-oppressive, identity-affirming frameworks.
long_description: Inclusive Therapists is a therapist directory specifically designed to connect clients with providers who center social justice, anti-oppression, and liberation in their practice. The platform helps clients find therapists who are affirming of marginalized identities including BIPOC, LGBTQ+, disabled, and neurodivergent individuals. Provider profiles emphasize therapeutic approach, identities, and commitment to justice-oriented care. At $10/month, it's one of the most affordable directory options while serving a specific niche of clients seeking culturally responsive, identity-affirming therapy.
